coverage.note: Collision-disabled parts include assembly fasteners, bearings, shaft sleeves, spool/coil reference solids, small guards/posts and decorative parts. The candidate does not claim complete cable/wire/small-hardware snag detection.

exclusions.additional_pattern: For each finger i, exclude wrist_palm versus finger_i_proximal and finger_i_proximal versus finger_i_distal. Exclude rigid rotor/spool/adjacent actuator housings using actual final body names. Keep non-adjacent main links and separate fingers enabled. Same-body geometry is automatically non-colliding.
exclusions.warning: Assembly fasteners, bearings, washers, shaft sleeves and spring-coil envelope solids must remain collision-disabled; their adjacent CAD overlaps are not free-space collisions. Do not disable all robot-robot contacts to hide proxy errors.

limitations: Rigid collision surfaces do not model TPU deformation, friction variation, adhesion, printed tolerances, worn joints, or tendon compliance. These belong to independently measured physical parameters.
CoACD threshold is a requested concavity metric, not a proven maximum geometric error. Recorded samples are reproducible diagnostic measurements, not a guaranteed bound.
Small screw holes/slots can be partly bridged by decomposition. Large service windows and finger fork gaps are tested at specified probe points; a probe pass does not certify the entire opening.
Internal assembly hardware contact and joint bearing deformation are deliberately excluded. Main structural and grasp-contact solids are included separately.

fast_variant.validation_policy: Benchmark FULL and FAST on the identical successful/failed trajectory before using FAST for sweeps. Recheck all reported key results with FULL. A speedup or identical classification is not presumed.
